_comment: The touch screen, keyboard, pen, trackpad and motion sensors: the virtio-input transport (DroidVMVirtioInput.c), NativeHidInput under the original IOHIDDevice of the 24A446 fileset with its bindings, the HID probe (HidInputProbe.cpp), the motion sysctl (DroidVMMotion.c), all built by build-droidvm-hid-input.py (kext-objects.json), and the sensor processor's channel (DroidVMSensorProcessor.cpp), as one kext of the kernel collection. Depends on IOHIDFamily, so OSKext loads it before NativeHidInput's metaclass is built. See scripts/build-droidvm-kexts.py.
name: DroidVMInput
